name: Parks and Recreation Teen Volunteers
org: City of Fullerton Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Help run city youth programs and special events in Fullerton. You work with kids, build your resume and can earn school service hours.
who_can_apply: Teens 15 and older use the teen application. The page puts a star by the age and does not explain it, so ask the city.
duration: Seasonal: fall, winter and spring, and summer
deadline_text: The city recruits volunteers each season (fall, winter and spring, and summer). No dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Volunteer Application on the city volunteer page and email it to FullertonCenter@cityoffullerton.com.
notes: Most volunteers help with day to day youth programs and events, or as needed. The page says the work can count for school community service or internship requirements. Adults 18 and up use a separate application. The Fullerton Public Library has its own teen volunteer program.
